quests.title: Project Connectivity

dialogue.t: Hello there! I'm Daya from Kshahrewar. Are you here to take part in the Wisdom Gala too?
This is the new game that our Darshan has put forth: "Project Connectivity"!
Would you like to have a go at it?

dialogue.sit: If I recall, Kshahrewar's specialty is...

dialogue.t: We study mechanics and architecture, yes.
Uh, seems like I've gone off-topic. So, to take part in this Gala, many of our students put their heads together...
Basically, players will need to use the various objects that we have prepared to... well, create a pathway.
Laying down bridges, setting up stairs... The eventual goal is to create a path for people to travel on that can reach its destination.
Once you have finished constructing that road, we will conduct a final verification, just like how we would test completed buildings.
Essentially, you just need to set up a safe road to attain success.

dialogue.sit: I haven't much of a knack for architecture.

dialogue.t: Don't worry, don't worry! You're not being asked to construct anything in real life.
If something goes wrong and the road collapses, we'll just have to rebuild it. We're not putting limits on the number of tries you have either.
Just let your imagination run free and build as beautiful as a road can be!

dialogue.sit: Sorry, I'm a little busy right now.

dialogue.t: Alright. In that case, if you'll look over this way...

quests.description: Daya from Kshahrewar seems to be busy with something…
